scope: Generic fictional childhood avatar for the age-eight benchmark; select an appropriate reusable pack before adapting other ages. This is an imagined avatar, not a real-person portrait.

provenance.character: Original project artwork generated with built-in image_gen on 2026-10-26 for the approved illustrated age-eight example.
provenance.audio: Original locally composed and synthesised instrumental and chime, 2026-10-26.
provenance.ui: Reusable native CSS markers and sprite animations; system-font controls and text remain HTML/CSS.

scene_style.description: Detailed hand-painted gouache and coloured-pencil storybook environments, warm paper light, sea-green foliage, weathered timber and soft ink detail. Side-on or shallow stage view with quiet walking space and horizontal ground near the lower edge. Fictional schematic memory places. Backgrounds contain no people, animals, text, logos or interface; use only source-supported details.

avatar.integration: Load stock.css before game.css; set data-moving and data-facing on the avatar from existing movement state. Keep dimensions or scale a wrapper to preserve baseline corrections. Freeze decorative animation with prefers-reduced-motion; keep player travel functional.

audio.enable: Only after an explicit user action. Provide a persistent mute button, including during dialogue. No autoplay or voice.

generation_policy.scene_cache: Exact style, scene prompt and atlas layout; cache reuse is not a QA result.
